decisions.summary: Shared mechanisms and phase order, unchanged since round 1.
decisions.why: Unchanged; each implements FR-001..FR-009 as written (round 1). P0's list does not yet carry the measurements D8 and D9 now rely on (the belt residual, the field-pond knob census) - a consistency edit, not a narrowing.

decisions.summary: A drop is taken only where it is the rule's own provision; a drop of a rolled or required feature is never a fallback, closed by constraining the knob or candidates beforehand.
decisions.why: Stricter than round 1's wording and matches FR-005: no violation is emitted.

decisions.summary: Seating floor by a ladder: exhaustive pass, then envelopes shrunk within their researched range via M5, then the seat band grown upslope 'until every household is seated'; claimed to terminate because each round adds ground.
decisions.why: The terminal round 1 asked for is still unstated, one step later. The growth runs 'away from the field', but the plan's own H03 (fit.py _parts_fit: every house within 700 ft of the field outline; H14's exhaustive pass scans only that ground) bounds legal ground, so 'each round adds ground' proves area added, not a seat found: the loop either reaches H03's bound with households unseated (the case left silent) or seats them past it (an H03 violation). The premise that upslope is 'the side the settlement can always extend on' is asserted, not measured, and 'each within its rules' names none of the rules that bound the growth - H03's reach, the belt band reserved before the hem (D8/H30 step 2, upwind and often upslope of the cluster), D4's resolved shape, the drain. Fix: bound the growth by those rules explicitly and state what happens when they stop it, emitting no shortfall and running no re-roll - e.g. a plan-time capacity bound computed by construction over the ground within reach (not a measured packing density), with a rolled household count constrained and a declared one refused at spec load as D3 does; or, if the session judges that terminal a change to the feature, put it to the GM with P0's measured count of seeds that reach it.

decisions.summary: A fall, declared or rolled, refused or constrained at spec resolution only when plan-time geometry (envelope, drain) shows no wind-facing margin above the drain; H30 steps (1)-(3) kept; Sawada untouched.
decisions.why: Now limited to the case where the drain rule and the wind rule physically cannot both hold, computed before any stage (an input constraint, not a finished-map check); Sawada's declared fall, which has a wind-facing margin, survives. Word it 'constrained' rather than 're-rolled' so it is not read against SC-003's 'no roll re-rolls'.

decisions.summary: cluster_shape resolves only over the shapes the chosen seat band admits, then steer and repair within it; no unhonored record.
decisions.why: The rule's purpose (GM 2026-08-24: a rolled knob is honored by what is drawn) is met; the knob narrows only where a shape is physically undrawable on that band, by the engine's existing affordance mechanism (L1's entrance_sitable, has_approach). D2's band growth runs after this and must keep the resolved shape (see D2).

decisions.summary: Brook ruled-run held by a stricter view-independent bound at the brook's placer.
decisions.why: Unchanged from round 1: stricter than the test, so the rule as tested holds.

decisions.summary: Bare-ground predicate counts recorded footprints and treads as covered.
decisions.why: Unchanged from round 1: the rule's own grounding ('the map admitting it has not decided what is there'); raised with the GM once it works, as the plan now says.

decisions.summary: A generated Mode A program with no legal seat is refused at composition.
decisions.why: Unchanged from round 1: a seedless composer refusing an unsatisfiable input before any sheet exists is not FR-002's finished-map raise.

decisions.summary: Belt band reserved before the hem, canvas sized for belt room, seat_cluster refuses a margin whose belt cannot be 30 ft deep and unbroken; P0 measures any residual; only a forced case goes to the GM with its count.
decisions.why: Replaces both violating forms with a construction; the GM is asked only for a residual shown forced, as round 1 required. P0's phase list must name this measurement (it currently lists only W48, the board and seed 31).

decisions.id: D9 (woods W25; burial own; water W29)
decisions.summary: Wood floor laid as an M5 part inside the envelope; hamlet_burial resolves own_ground only where edge_seat finds a legal seat; a rolled field-pond count treated likewise, else recorded as not a rule.
decisions.why: The wood floor is within (a construction). The burial and pond parts narrow a knob to what the site affords, the same affordance mechanism as D4/L1; stage_burial resolves its knob after the houses stand (burial.py), so the seat is known at resolution. A pinned own_ground with no seat is not covered and should be stated (pins are declared input).

decisions.summary: No caption overlaps on any sheet: leader line, then the sheet's key; least-cost overlapping seat retired everywhere.
decisions.why: Resolves round 1's X2: the GM's words are 'labels mandatory' (standard.py), which a leader or key entry honors; the least-cost seat was the session's mechanism.

decisions.summary: Worked woodland off a tight sheet recorded off the sheet with its bearing.
decisions.why: As ruled in round 1: research/vegetation/220 and the GM's frame rule answer it; raised once it works.

decisions.summary: GM question on the board with no clean verge: no board / board farther off the way / caption breaking a rule on a leader, with P0's count.
decisions.why: Every terminal breaks one of the GM's own rulings and the research is silent; the ask now lists the three options the designs name and carries the measured count, as round 1 required.
